title: Video by baptisteodonovan
description:
Comment REPOS down below and I'll send them to you directly.

These 5 GitHub repos just blew up this week, and every single one is completely free.

The first is OpenClaude, which was the #1 repo last week . It's basically Claude Code, but it runs on any model you want, even free local ones. you get the Claude feeling, but with the ability to use any cheaper intelligence.

The second is Invidious. It's YouTube with zero ads, zero tracking, and no account needed, so you never sit through another unskippable ad.

The third is OpenMAIC, built by researchers at Tsinghua University. It gives you an entire classroom of AI teachers in one click, and yhou can learn any topic you care about for $0.

The fourth is Academic Research Skills, sitting at almost 45,000 stars. It hunts down references, formats citations, and checks your logic, it's perfect if you are a uni student or doing any kind of research.

And finally, MiniMind, which lets you train your own AI model completely from scratch, in just 2 hours, for under 50 cents, so you finally understand how these models actually work.

So if you guys want the links to all 5, just comment REPOS down below and I'll send them to you directly.
